name: Tribes & Thrones
summary: Tribes & Thrones is a free-to-play fantasy city-building and strategy game for browser and mobile, played in four-week rounds by up to 150 players. Two factions fight for a single throne: at launch, the Dwarves of the Empire face the Orcs of the Free Peoples. Players gather wood, stone, iron, food and gold, research a tech tree, forge weapons and armour, train armies, found further cities and raid camps and beasts in the borderlands. Battles are resolved automatically on the server without rock-paper-scissors counters; mixed armies deal more damage. Factions join forces in war marches to take four watch fortresses, which become their castles. Holding three fortresses allows an attack on the throne, guarded by the boss Kaldur, Keeper of the Throne. The faction that holds the throne for 72 hours wins the round. Capitals cannot be conquered and there are no in-game purchases. The game is currently available in German only.
